sentences.en: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
sentences.zh: 我妻子兼职赚了一些额外的钱。

sentences.en: Do you have an extra English dictionary by any chance?
sentences.zh: 你有空闲的英文字典吗？

sentences.en: The extra room proved very useful when we had visitors.
sentences.zh: 多出来的那间房在我们有客人的时候非常有用。
